strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hey, hey, so what are we gonna do now?
I told you to cut the chatter, they'll find us.
I know, but... how long are we gonna stay like this?
Can't be helped! The Satsuki Midori blast fried our spare batteries.
No point running out of gas before we meet up!
Out of gas... Passing gas... Heh heh... heh heh heh heh...
Izumi! You little... Right when I'm already ticked off...
Wait, something's coming!
The Nadesico...!?
We should be okay here. Sayaka, the distress signal...
It's already sent, Koji.
Looks like Londo Bell is heading our way.
Whew... Still... having to wait for help out in the middle of nowhere...
It's pretty embarrassing.
Quit your grumbling, Koji. You gotta stay alive to do anything!
True. We managed to shake off those clay figurine things, but...
...we've strayed pretty far from the original rendezvous point.
I know it was to protect the HLV we were riding in, but...
No telling what became of Dancougar after it bailed out up there...
Fujiwara's way too reckless.
We're safe thanks to them, so we can't complain too much.
Yeah. But... something's off about this place too.
This damage... Looks like it was wrecked just recently.
Satsuki Midori 2... An asteroid colony that's also a Federation relay base.
And now it's like this. Looks like space is in turmoil too.
Anyway, let's hurry up and meet up with Bright... Hm!?
Koji?
Wh-wh-what!? What the heck are these things!?
Koji! These robots... the Jovian Lizards!?
Heh... Would've been nice if it was Londo Bell coming to greet us.
Doesn't look like they followed us here, though.
They were hiding and watching...!?
Someone beat us here... No, looks like they're the ones who did this!
Whoa! Whoa! Hey, hey, that robot in the middle is sooo cool!
Like a big hunk of steel!
...Mazinger Z...!? What's it doing here!?
An abandoned colony... Well, it beats floating around in space.
I've sent out a distress signal.
Now we just have to wait, and Londo Bell should come for us, Tetsuya.
Just wait... That's pretty boring, though.
I'm in the mood to cut loose.
If you're that eager, you should've gone with the Cyber Beast Force
and jumped out back then, shouldn't you?
Don't be crazy, Tetsuya!
Jumping out in the stratosphere? Those guys are totally nuts!
Even so, they did it to lure the Gaizok battleship away from the HLV, right?
We should be thanking them, not complaining.
It's their methods that are the problem.
We came to bolster the forces, yet the Cyber Beast Force is lost,
and we're way off the rendezvous, awaiting rescue at a dead colony...
This defeats the whole purpose.
Harsh as ever, Tetsuya.
Don't be so on edge right now. Let's just wait, okay?
I've got reason to be. Doesn't this colony seem... strange to you, Jun?
...Strange how?
This damage... is recent. I checked the data. Satsuki Midori 2...
...is an asteroid colony that doubles as a Federation relay base.
Looks like space is in turmoil too. Let's hurry and meet up...
Tetsuya! These guys are...!
Yeah. They call them the Jovian Lizards. ...Heh, am I losing my touch...
If we're not careful, we'll go missing just like the Cyber Beast Force.
Whoa! Whoa! Hey, hey, that robot in the middle is sooo cool!
Like a big hunk of steel!
...Great Mazinger...!? What's it doing here!?
This is no time to be talking about that, you two.
The lizards have started moving.
Should we go help...?
No, we wait here. ...If we can just buy time until the Nadesico arrives...
More of 'em!?
Just how many are hiding here!?
Isn't Londo Bell here yet!?
Wh-whoa, th-that's close!?
Making such a racket! Did they spot us!?
Has the Reaper come to greet us?
No way in hell! We're heading out, Hikaru, Izumi!
Wh-what!? More of them!?
Can you hear us, Mazinger Z!? We're on your side!
So don't go firing your arms at us!
And spare us the hot stuff too~
Who are you!?
Don't worry about it! We were just hiding.
Nice to meet you, Mazinger Z.
Hiding!? I'm Koji Kabuto! Who the heck are you!?
Wow! It really is Koji Kabuto!
Just like in the Super Robot Encyclopedia: Japan Edition!
Who cares who we are! The lizard bastards are coming!
What do we do, Koji?
What else!? Either way... we kick these lizard machines outta here!
Let's go!
(Their robots... I've seen them somewhere before...
...Could they be from the Nadesico?)
Reinforcements...!? There were more hiding!?
Just how many are in this colony!?
Isn't Londo Bell here yet!?
Wh-whoa, th-that's close!?
Making such a racket! Did they spot us!?
Has the Reaper come to greet us?
No way in hell! We're heading out, Hikaru, Izumi!
Wh-what!? More of them!?
Can you hear us, Great Mazinger!? We're on your side!
So don't go firing your arms at us!
And spare us the lightning too~
Who are you!?
Don't worry about it! We were just hiding.
Nice to meet you, Great Mazinger.
Hiding, you say...? Who are you people?
Depending on your answer, I'll crush you all together.
Yikes! He's way scarier than the lizards!
Who cares who we are! The lizard bastards are coming!
What do we do, Tetsuya?
For now... we hit the Jovian Lizard machines. ...These girls are probably...
(If memory serves, they're the same model that left the Nadesico...)
...A reading!? Koji! They're here!
All riiight! Been waiting for you, Bright!
...A reading!? Tetsuya! They're here!
Londo Bell!
Ryoko, this is...
Yeah, it's them!
Ta-daaa! The Nadesico has arrived!
Satsuki Midori 2... It's already... destroyed...!?
Is that... the Nadesico!?
That's... the Nadesico!?
Confirming the Aestivalis units with the replacement pilots.
There's some black thing here too, though.
Don't call me a black thing! Why's the Nadesico showing up!?
Whoa-ho! It's Mazinger Z! Hey! Tenkawa!
The Nadesico!? What's the meaning of this!?
Isn't Londo Bell's flagship supposed to be coming!?
Whoa-ho! It's Great Mazinger! Hey! Tenkawa!
Wh-what's it doing here!?
Oh my, sorry to disappoint you. Our business is with them over there.
We've been called~
Heh, you're late!
Just sortie already!
All units, launch!
There are only two, though.
What do we do about the Mazinger!?
What do we do about Great Mazinger!?
Hmmm. ...I'd love to have it.
If we analyzed it, Nergal's technology would likely leap ahead ten years.
My hands are itching! A Photon Power engine~
You're itching to take it apart, huh!? Fine, I'll take you all on!
My hands are itching! Super Alloy New Z! Heh heh heh...
Tch, Lizards ahead, Nadesico behind. ...Come at me and I'll show no mercy...!
Enemy contacts behind the Nadesico.
Whaaat!?
Nothing on radar...? Are they capable of perfect stealth!?
Wh-what are those robots!?
E-enemies!? Oh! Could these be Londo Bell!?
Nah, no way. Guys with a sickle and a spear... Well, we do have a few.
Which is it!?
They're enemies!
Heh! What a pain! I don't care who you are, come at me all you want!
Hey, Koji! We've never fought these enemies before! Be more careful...
Sayaka, it's no use.
Back when I was fighting Dr. Hell, I fought a different robot every time!
I won't lose to the lizards or these guys, sending out the same junk!
I hope so... but they're clearly not.
Besides, Londo Bell should have hardly any mass-produced units.
Which is it!?
They're enemies!
Sneaky, annoying bunch. Come at me head-on...!
Tetsuya! Don't get too cocky, okay!?
Don't be naive, Jun!
If we don't regain our combat instincts soon, it'll get us killed!
We got plenty of that back fighting the Gaizok on the ground.
Jun, that Tetsuya just hasn't had enough of a brawl, that's all.
...Heh.
We'll form a joint front with the Mazinger team! Commence attack!
No choice but to fight...! Here I go.
Kabuto!
Oh, it's really you this time! You're a lifesaver, Bright!
Uh-oh!
Wow, the Nadesico's here too. Nice catch, Koji!
That's not exactly how it went.
That silhouette... It must be! Tetsuya Tsurugi, is that you!?
That's... a Federation ship...! So you finally made it, Londo Bell!
Uh-oh!
Wow, the Nadesico's here too. Nice catch, Tetsuya!
That's not exactly how it went.
...That's right. Oh, don't mind us.
I can't do that. ...You have my thanks for backing up the Mazinger team.
But... that doesn't change the fact that we must pursue you.
So our positions haven't changed, then.
Precisely. I'd tell you to disarm at once... but given the circumstances...
Hmmm...
There's no need for people of Earth to fight each other here!
We don't intend to harm you. Please surrender!
Uuugh, what should we do, Prospector?
Even so, as things stand, Nergal is in no position to say yes.
Enemy contacts.
What!? From where!?
These guys...! The robots that were fighting that ship, the Elshank!?
What!? There was no reading! Where did they come from...
Phase transition engine, full power! Aestivalis team, return at once!
Yurika!?
It's now or never! We're shaking off every last one of them!
All right! Hikaru, Izumi! We're pulling out!
Okaaay! Leave this to me, everybody go!
You're coming back too, Gai!
The Nadesico's robots are...!?
Hey, wait up, you guys...!
Damn! These guys...!
Nadesico, rapid about-face! ...We'll leave the rest to you!
Damn it...!
Aww, they got away...
Caught off guard...! Nadesico... no, Misumaru's girl is no pushover.
Hey, Captain! This doesn't look like the time to be impressed.
Those descending to Earth, those rising up from Earth...
They attack both. I can't see their intent.
Let's see... Maybe they'll take any target at all.
Those robots were unmanned, weren't they?
Even if they're unmanned, someone had to program them...
Who cares about that now!? Hurry up and back us up!
Sheesh, Sayaka's gone hysterical.
All right, all units sortie and destroy the enemy units individually!
Grendizer...! Daisuke!?
Koji, thanks for coming...!
Kojiii!
Daisuke! Maria too...! Dai... No, Duke Fleed!
I'm gonna fight alongside you again. For Earth...!
Yes, let's fight together, Koji...!
This is no time for a chat!
Hurry it up already!
All right, all units sortie and destroy the enemy units individually!
Grendizer! Daisuke, I never thought I'd see you again...!
Tetsuya... Your skills haven't dulled, have they?
This war... will likely be the greatest yet... Are you prepared!?
Who do you think you're talking to? Even if Great got sent to a museum,
I never skipped a single day of training!
Tetsuya! What about Koji... Where's Koji!?
He's fighting the enemies on the ground.
By the time space quiets down, Koji will have handled things down there.
Show me the power of the great hero once more, Tetsuya!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Looks like it's over. Geez, it was the same on the ground,
every time we try to meet up with our friends, this happens.
It can't be helped. That's when things get the most hectic.
That's right, Koji. You're always complaining.
C'mon, Maria! Anyone would wanna complain about this!
Kabuto, may I? Welcome aboard once again. Please lend us your strength.
Heh heh... Welcome back, Koji.
Yeah! Leave it to Mazinger again!
Tetsuya's down on the ground, so there's nothing to worry about!
True, he should be fine.
Unlike you, he's fine even when no one's watching him, Koji.
That's harsh, Daisuke.
Kabuto, isn't Dancougar... the Cyber Beast Force with you?
Oh, that's right! The Cyber Beast Force is... out of contact.
Is that the end of it?
It happens every time, but meeting up never goes smoothly, does it?
It can't be helped. That's exactly when we're easiest to target.
I'm sorry, Tetsuya. If only I'd gotten here sooner...
No, Daisuke. It made for a good warm-up.
Tsurugi, isn't Dancougar... the Cyber Beast Force with you?
...No. The Cyber Beast Force split off midway to intercept the enemy...
and we've lost contact with them since...
If only Great had been built for space in the first place... Damn it.
What do you mean? Don't tell me... they were shot down...
Nah, not like that.
Those guys went after the Gaizok battleship chasing our launch pod,
and jumped out in the stratosphere to intercept it.
Whaaat!? You're kidding! There's no way they could fight properly...
...Then again, that's just like them.
Once tuned, the one Dr. Hazuki, now Far East Branch Commander, built...
...that super robot could fight anywhere. However...
However? I've never seen it... Is it really that amazing a robot?
Apparently it's not fully tuned yet.
We tried to stop them... but they just said, "Let's do this!"...
At its best... in the last war, in that strange Muge universe,
it was the only robot that could fight.
The stratosphere shouldn't be any trouble, but...
They did say it wasn't done being tuned...
That's insane. Judau and Roux were pretty reckless too, but still.
It can't be helped.
All right, once all units are aboard, the Ra Cailum heads to the next point...!
Broadcast our position at regular intervals!
Captain! You're giving up on them that easily...?
It only shows how much the Captain trusts them,
Lieutenant Uraki.
They get their best results going it alone... A troublesome bunch.
